commitMessage: fix: remove 17 unimplemented cudnn DECLARE_PLATFORM entries causing LNK1120
notes: CUDA/Triton rebuild failed after new vision_embedding_merge.cu was picked up. First native error: NDArray::cast returns NDArray*, but helper assigned it into stack NDArray at vision_embedding_merge.cu:192/200. Fixed by dispatching native text/vision/token dtypes directly instead of allocating cast temporaries.
